title: Judgment for Idolatry in Egypt

questions.question: The word came to Jeremiah concerning all the Judeans living in the land of Egypt. The Lord reminds them of the disaster he brought on Jerusalem. Why did this disaster happen?
options: "Because of the evil that they committed, provoking me to anger, in that they went to make offerings and serve other gods"
"Because they refused to pay tribute to Babylon"
"Because they trusted in Pharaoh for chariots"
questions.correctAnswer: "Because of the evil that they committed, provoking me to anger, in that they went to make offerings and serve other gods"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 44:3 (ESV): "because of the evil that they committed, provoking me to anger, in that they went to make offerings and serve other gods that they knew not,"

questions.question: The Lord said he persistently sent his servants the prophets to say what?
options: "Oh, do not do this abomination that I hate!"
"Turn back to the covenant of Moses!"
questions.correctAnswer: "Oh, do not do this abomination that I hate!"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 44:4 (ESV): "Yet I persistently sent to you all my servants the prophets, saying, 'Oh, do not do this abomination that I hate!'"

questions.question: The Lord asks the exiles in Egypt, "Why do you provoke me to anger with the works of your hands, making... to other gods in the land of Egypt where you have come to live?"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 44:8 (ESV): "Why do you provoke me to anger with the works of your hands, making offerings to other gods in the land of Egypt where you have come to live,"

questions.question: "Have you forgotten the evil of your fathers, the evil of the kings of Judah, the evil of their... , your own evil, and the evil of your... , which they committed in the land of Judah...?"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 44:9 (ESV): "Have you forgotten the evil of your fathers, the evil of the kings of Judah, the evil of their wives, your own evil, and the evil of your wives,"

questions.question: "They have not humbled themselves even to this day, nor have they... , nor walked in my law and my statutes that I set before you and before your fathers."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 44:10 (ESV): "They have not humbled themselves even to this day, nor have they feared, nor walked in my law and my statutes"

questions.question: "Behold, I will set my face against you for harm, to cut off all..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 44:11 (ESV): "Behold, I will set my face against you for harm, to cut off all Judah."

questions.question: Who will escape or survive to return to the land of Judah, out of the remnant that came to dwell in Egypt?
options: None of them, except some fugitives
questions.correctAnswer: None of them, except some fugitives
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 44:14 (ESV): "so that none of the remnant of Judah who have come to live in the land of Egypt shall escape or survive or return to the land of Judah... For none shall return except some fugitives."

questions.question: How did all the men (who knew their wives had made offerings to other gods) and all the women who stood by, an assembly, answer Jeremiah?
options: "As for the word that you have spoken to us in the name of the Lord, we will not listen to you."
"We repent and will tear down the altars."
"We only did it because we were forced."
"Pray he forgives us just one more time."
questions.correctAnswer: "As for the word that you have spoken to us in the name of the Lord, we will not listen to you."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 44:16 (ESV): "As for the word that you have spoken to us in the name of the Lord, we will not listen to you."

questions.question: They vowed to continue making offerings and pouring out drink offerings to what foreign deity?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 44:17 (ESV): "But we will do everything that we have vowed, make offerings to the queen of heaven and pour out drink offerings to her,"

questions.question: What psychological justification did the people give for worshipping this deity?
options: "For then we had plenty of food, and prospered, and saw no disaster."
"Because the Queen of Heaven commanded us in a dream."
"Because it is the custom of Egypt."
questions.correctAnswer: "For then we had plenty of food, and prospered, and saw no disaster."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 44:17 (ESV): "as we did, both we and our fathers, our kings and our officials, in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem. For then we had plenty of food, and prospered, and saw no disaster."

questions.question: What did they claim happened since they left off making offerings to the Queen of Heaven?
options: "We have lacked everything and have been consumed by the sword and by famine."
questions.correctAnswer: "We have lacked everything and have been consumed by the sword and by famine."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 44:18 (ESV): "But since we left off making offerings to the queen of heaven and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have lacked everything and have been consumed by the sword and by famine."

questions.question: Jeremiah replied that the Lord could no longer bear their evil deeds and abominations. Because of this, their land had become a desolation... "because you made... and sinned against the Lord"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 44:23 (ESV): "It is because you made offerings and because you sinned against the Lord and did not obey the voice of the Lord... that this disaster has happened to you,"

questions.question: The Lord swore by His great name that His name would no more be invoked by any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt saying what phrase?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 44:26 (ESV): "Behold, I have sworn by my great name, says the Lord, that my name shall no more be invoked by the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt, saying, 'As the Lord God lives.'"

questions.question: As a sign to them that His words for harm would surely stand against them, who did the Lord say He would give into the hand of his enemies who sought his life?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 44:30 (ESV): "Thus says the Lord: Behold, I will give Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies and into the hand of those who seek his life,"

questions.question: Just as the Lord handed over Pharaoh Hophra to his enemies, who had he previously given over to his enemy (Nebuchadnezzar)?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 44:30 (ESV): "as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who was his enemy and sought his life."

key_verse_text: "Yet I persistently sent to you all my servants the prophets, saying, 'Oh, do not do this abomination that I hate!'"
